critical_code_review_comments: POSTerminal.jsx file is 746 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting SwipeableCartItem (already a self-contained component), Cash/Split/QR/UPI dialog components into separate files.

BottomDock.jsx line 121 path.replace('/', '') only replaces FIRST '/' which is fine for single-segment paths like /staff-roster → 'staff-roster' but would silently break for nested routes. Use .replace(/^\//, '') or .substring(1) for clarity.
POSTerminal SwipeableCartItem: catch block in onPointerUp (line 42) swallows error silently — should at least console.warn. Minor.
POSTerminal line 89 & 386 & 408: image fallback string is duplicated 3 times — extract to a const PLACEHOLDER_IMG.
